site: Steven Stamkos got the scoring started for the Predators midway through the first, but Connor Dewar made it 1-1 for Pittsburgh just 18 seconds into the second.
rewrite: Steven Stamkos got the scoring started for the Predators midway through the first, and Connor Dewar answered for Pittsburgh just 18 seconds into the second to make it 1-1.

site: Jayden Struble scored his first goal for Nashville early in the second to put the Predators ahead 2-1.
With the goalie pulled and just over a minute left, Rickard Rakell tied it 2-2 for Pittsburgh.
rewrite: Jayden Struble scored his first goal for Nashville early in the second to put the Predators back ahead 2-1, and the lead held until Rickard Rakell tied it 2-2 with the goalie pulled and just over a minute left.

site: Ville Koivunen won it in overtime.
rewrite: Ville Koivunen won it in overtime.

site: The Penguins carried the play, outshooting the Predators 37-26, but needed overtime to win it.
Artūrs Šilovs made 24 saves for the Penguins, and Juuse Saros kept the Preds in it, stopping 34 of 37.
rewrite: The Penguins carried the play, outshooting the Predators 37-26, but needed overtime to win it, because Juuse Saros kept the Preds in it with 34 saves on 37 shots.
Artūrs Šilovs made 24 saves at the other end.

site: Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Elmer Söderblom, even with Koivunen’s overtime winner in the game, by our Swing measure.
rewrite: By our Swing measure, nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Elmer Söderblom, even with Koivunen’s overtime winner in the game.

site: Only two penalties were called all night, something the league sees about once every 20 games.

site: The Penguins improved to 5-6-1, sixth in the Metropolitan.
The Predators fell to 3-3-4, seventh in the Central.
